{{Quote|Bail Antilles remains the front-runner. Ironically, the crisis at Naboo has drawn the Core Worlds into a tighter circle. Where Antilles has always been in danger of being dismissed as the candidate most likely to follow in Valorum's footsteps, he is suddenly the darling of those advocating for strong, central authority.|[[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]]|<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>}}
'''Bail Antilles''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Politics/Legends|politician]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. [[Reproduction/Legends|Born]] as a [[Prince/Legends|prince]] in the influential [[House of Antilles]], Antilles served as the [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of the [[Alderaan sector/Legends|Alderaan sector]] during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] leading up to the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]. Campaigning to combat corruption in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]], the legislative body of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Antilles ascended to the position of [[Chairman/Legends|chairman]] of the [[Internal Activities Committee/Legends|Internal Activities Committee]]. He was also leader of one of the two main factions of the Senate, the [[Core Faction|Core faction]], which was mostly opposed by the [[Rim Faction|Rim faction]] led by his colleague [[Ainlee Teem/Legends|Ainlee Teem]] of the planet [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].

In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], during the debates on the [[Senate Resolution BR-0371|taxation]] of [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]], Antilles argued the Senate should not allow the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] to increase the number of its [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|defenses]]. [[32 BBY/Legends|One year later]], [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] of the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] moved for a [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|Vote of No Confidence]] in the leadership of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]]. Along with his colleagues [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of Naboo and Ainlee Teem, Antilles was nominated to succeed the Chancellor. Despite&mdash;or partly because of&mdash;his crusade against corruption, Antilles was not chosen, and Palpatine received the [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|anointing]] of the Senate. Following Palpatine's election at the helm of the state, Antilles retired from office, making way for his compatriot [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], to whom he was related through [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]]. Once he was retired, Antilles still made a few public appearances, notably attending Senator [[Horox Ryyder/Legends|Horox Ryyder's]] farewell party shortly before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|outbreak]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

==Biography==
===Early life and career===
{{Quote|There, all but in Valorum's lap, sit Senators Antilles, Horox Ryyder, Tendau Bendon&hellip; Any of them, more than worthy of a bow.|Senator Orn Free Taa|<ref name="cod">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Alderaan.jpg|thumb|left|175px|Peaceful Alderaan, Antilles' homeworld]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Bail Antilles was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]],<ref name="db" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that had been an established center point in the culture and [[Politics/Legends|politics]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] for thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="UVG">''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]''</ref> The young Antilles, a [[Prince/Legends|prince]] by birth on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]],<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> was a prominent member of the [[House of Antilles]], one of the planet's most influential [[Noble/Legends|noble]] bloodlines.<ref name="CSWEhoa" /> In accordance with [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] law, Antilles reached the [[age of responsibility]] at seventeen, becoming a full adult independent of his [[Parent/Legends|parents]].<ref name="RD">The novel ''[[Rebel Dawn]]'' specifies that the Alderaanian [[age of responsibility]] was set at seventeen.</ref> He joined [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]]-wide politics by succeeding his elder colleague [[Agrippa Aldrete/Legends|Agrippa Aldrete]]<ref name="senatoraldrete">{{InsiderCite|90|Refresher Reading}}</ref> as the [[Alderaan sector/Legends|Alderaan sector's]] [[Senator/Legends|delegate]] to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]],<ref name="who" /> the main legislative and executive council of the Republic.<ref name="DBSenate">{{DB|organization|galacticsenate|Galactic Senate}}</ref> He occupied a highly prestigious position, since Alderaan was one of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]&mdash;a group of prestigious planets located around the center of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]&mdash;and [[Alderaanian delegation/Legends|its delegation]] held considerable power in the [[Grand Convocation Chamber|Senate Rotunda]].<ref name="YJCCG">{{YJCCG|set=Battle of Naboo|cardname=Alderaan Diplomat|link=battleofnaboo/light/large/26alderaandiplomatsenator.html}}</ref> Apart from his political career, Antilles started a family by [[Marriage/Legends|marrying]] a [[Bail Antilles's wife|woman]], with whom he lived on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]&mdash;the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of the Republic&mdash;during his Senatorial service.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> On Coruscant, Antilles was known to visit the [[Coruscant Opera/Legends|Coruscant Opera House]], like many other politicians of the [[Time/Legends|time]]. He notably attended a representation of ''[[The Brief Reign of Future Wraiths]]'', a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Opera/Legends|opera]] performed by a touring [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Unidentified Bith opera company|company]].<ref name="cod" />

Toward the end of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum's]] administration, Antilles was a known supporter of the Chancellor. At that time, the Senate was mostly divided into two factions: the liberal [[Core Faction|Core faction]], led by Antilles and traditionally supporting Valorum, and the conservative [[Rim Faction|Rim faction]], opposed to Valorum's measures and led by Senator [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]] of the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. Both [[Ainlee Teem/Legends|Ainlee Teem]] and Antilles were considered plausible successors to Valorum by many, including the Chancellor himself. During that time, corruption was a thorn in the flesh of the Senate. Antilles decided to go on a crusade against it, becoming a paragon of integrity. He joined the [[Internal Activities Committee/Legends|Internal Activities Committee]], a core group whose role was to maintain ethics and legality among the high-ranking officials of the Republic. He was even appointed [[Chairman/Legends|chairman]] of the Committee, which also included [[Horox Ryyder/Legends|Horox Ryyder]] of the world [[Gravlex Med/Legends|Gravlex Med]], [[Yarua/Legends|Yarua]] of the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and nominally [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] of the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Antilles would retain that position for years until his retirement.<ref name="cod" /> During the last [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of his service, he was assisted by two [[Senatorial aide]]s: the former Senator Aldrete<ref name="agrippa">{{DB|character|aldrete|Aldrete, Agrippa}}</ref> and [[Liana Merian/Legends|Liana Merian]], a female [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] also from Alderaan.<ref name="liana">{{DB|character|lianamerian|Merian, Liana}}</ref>

===The taxation debates===
{{Quote|Supreme Chancellor, I'm sorry to have to be the bearer of raw tidings on a day that should be devoted to celebration, but this document constitutes official notification that you are hereby requested to appear before the Supreme Court to answer allegations of corruption and illegal enrichment.|Antilles, to Chancellor Valorum|<ref name="cod" />}}
[[File:BailAgrippa_TPM.png|thumb|right|250px|Senator Antilles confers with Agrippa Aldrete, one of his aides.]]
In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], a shipping interest that monopolized the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], suffered from attacks by the criminal organization known as the [[Nebula Front/Legends|Nebula Front]] in several [[Sector/Legends|sectors]]. Through the voice of its representative in the Senate, [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]], the Federation petitioned for Republic aid. Chancellor Valorum proposed a taxation of the [[Free Trade Zone/Legends|Free Trade Zone]], a solution of which the Federation disapproved. Dod suggested that alternatively the Trade Federation could increase its own security assets, thus not needing the protection of the Republic. Dod's idea was supported by Ainlee Teem, but Antilles protested, as it could endanger the stability of<ref name="cod" /> the already dangerous<ref name="db" /> Outer Rim. He suggested instead that the Trade Federation simply avoid the dangerous areas. The Alderaanian's intervention, however, was not to the liking of some representatives, whose planets would be excluded from galactic trade because of the measure. As the problem was considered a delicate matter, a [[Eriadu Trade Summit|summit]] was arranged on the planet [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] to discuss it at a later date.<ref name="cod" />

Soon afterward, Antilles and Ryyder attempted to meet privately with Valorum. That follow-up meeting did not happen, because the Nebula Front [[Attack on Supreme Chancellor Valorum|attempted]] to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] Valorum in the [[Senate Plaza/Legends|Senate Plaza]]. Their plan, however, was thwarted by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], and the Chancellor was merely wounded. Antilles obtained proof of the Front's involvement in the incident and, along with Senator [[Com Fordox]] of the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], paid the recovering politician a social visit at the [[Galactic Senate Medcenter/Legends|Galactic Senate Medcenter]]. Later, a recovered Valorum thanked Antilles for his interest by consulting him&mdash;along with Ryyder, Palpatine, and a few [[Aide/Legends|aides]]&mdash;about a hostage situation. The Republic starship [[Prominence (Consular-class)|''Prominence'']], which had been transporting a delegation of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] on a [[Mission to Asmeru|mission]], had been attacked by Nebula Front [[Agent/Legends|agents]], and the starship's occupants had been captured. Since most of the hostages were [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Antilles and the other politicians agreed to leave the matter in the hands of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].<ref name="cod" />

While working to resolve a diplomatic crisis between Alderaan and its neighbor planet [[Delaya/Legends|Delaya]], Antilles was approached by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] senator [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]] of the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. As a member of several committees, Taa had discovered that the trade company known as [[Valorum Shipping and Transport]], owned by [[House Valorum/Legends|relatives]] of Chancellor Valorum and with interests in the trade routes that Valorum wanted to tax, had received an important investment and would profit from the new laws for which Valorum was campaigning&mdash;something that suggested corruption. Taa had tried to find the origin of the [[Currency/Legends|money]], but on account of lacking the proper authorization, he had turned to Antilles due to his chairmanship of the Internal Activities Committee, on Palpatine's advice. Antilles agreed to investigate the situation, discovering what he at first thought was a false-venture consortium. Hidden under it was a fraudulent banking account from Coruscant that had moved an amount of [[Aurodium/Legends|aurodium]] [[ingot]]s apparently linked to the Trade Federation. Those facts suggested that the Federation had given Valorum the ingots to seal a secret pact. Antilles reported his discoveries to Taa, who in turn revealed them to Palpatine discreetly.<ref name="cod" />

Once the taxing of trade routes had been [[Senate Resolution BR-0371|approved]], Antilles, in his role as Internal Activities chairman, informed Valorum of the charges of corruption filed against him. The Alderaanian also represented the prosecution in the subsequent [[Supreme Court/Legends|Supreme Court]] [[Supreme Court inquiry against Finis Valorum|inquiry]] that took place in the [[Galactic Courts of Justice/Legends|Galactic Courts of Justice Building]]. When Antilles presented evidence of embezzlement related to Valorum Shipping and Transport, one of the Chancellor's lawyers objected there was no clear connection between Valorum himself and the enormous sum that was invested in the corporation. Yet Antilles had expected that argument. He pointed out that the quantity of aurodium corresponded exactly to a cache of ingots that the Trade Federation had reported missing after an [[Dorvalla Incident|attack]] a few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] earlier. He went on to note that the money in question might not have truly disappeared, and might have instead been transferred to Valorum Shipping, as a means to seal a concealed partnership between the Federation and the Chancellor. Following those accusations, Valorum's reputation was put on the line, and as his second term of office drew to a close, both Antilles and Teem started campaigning to replace him.<ref name="cod" />

===The Invasion of Naboo and the Chancery election===
{{Quote|Who else has been nominated?''"<br />"''Bail Antilles of Alderaan and Ainlee Teem of Malastare.|Queen Amidala of Naboo and her chief of security, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]]|<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>}}
[[File:ZodKneelsBeforeAmidala-TPMHD.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Following the Invasion of Naboo, Valorum was ousted from office.]]
Unbeknownst to the Senate, the Trade Federation had entered into a secret alliance with the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious&mdash;who was in fact none other than the seemingly unassuming Senator Palpatine.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Sidious ordered his Federation allies to use their [[Battleship/Legends|battleships]] to [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] and besiege Naboo, in protest against the taxation of the Free Trade Zone. Facing the current head of state's impotence to act quickly and interrupt the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|blockade]], [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], the recently elected ruler of Naboo, called for a [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|Vote of No Confidence]] in Chancellor Valorum's leadership.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

The motion was greeted with resounding success, and Valorum was removed from office. As a consequence, Antilles, Teem and Palpatine were nominated to succeed Valorum in the upcoming [[Supreme Chancellor election, 32 BBY/Legends|Chancery election]].<ref name="TPM" /> Since Antilles had gained popularity following the taxation debates, he was considered the top candidate for the chancellorship by both the [[Journalist/Legends|holomedia]] and his fellow senators. During the campaign, Antilles organized a political meeting aboard the [[Perlemian Orbital Facility]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] Coruscant. The meeting was attended by several senators and businessbeings, as well as Jedi Master [[Jorus C'baoth]], who had been tasked with settling a [[Alderaan Ascendancy Contention|dispute]] among some of Alderaan's noble houses.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> However, thanks to the groundswell of sympathy for the blockaded planet Naboo, Palpatine won the election.<ref name="db" /><ref name="TPM" /> Antilles' fierce fight against corruption had also gained him a reputation of an overzealous reformer, which rendered him undesirable to the many greedy delegates in the Senate,<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> and he resigned from the Senate shortly thereafter. He passed the torch to his compatriot [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]],<ref name="db" /> who had married Queen [[Breha Organa/Legends|Breha]], a member of Antilles' family.<ref name="Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref>

===A retired senator===
{{Quote|Among the politicians present at the gathering were Senator Bail Organa and former Senator Bail Antilles of Alderaan.|A HoloNet News headline|<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|48|news/13321_3.html|Senator Horox Ryyder Retires}}</ref>}}
[[File:Horoxryyder.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Former Senator Antilles and his successor Bail Organa paying tribute to retiring Senator Horox Ryyder]]
Despite having sustained an overwhelming defeat, Antilles held no grudge against Palpatine for being elected. In fact, he assumed that the former Senator of Naboo had been chosen because he projected an image of both rigidness and sincerity, which gained him the sympathy and approval of both Senatorial factions. However, Antilles would somewhat revise his opinion through the years: he later revealed to Bail Organa that, at that time of Palpatine's election, the Senate's main objective had been to remove Valorum from power, more than any actual interest in his successor.<ref name="loe">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>

In the third month of the year [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Antilles accompanied Bail Organa to [[Ozlyn Gox/Legends|Ozlyn Gox]], the capital [[City/Legends|city]] of Gravlex Med, to attend the retirement ceremony of the [[Anx/Legends|Anx]] representative Horox Ryyder.<ref name="db" /><ref name="HNN" /> The celebration was an informal gathering of old friends, but Ryyder had been careful to invite his former political allies, including Antilles. The two Alderaanians presented their retiring colleague with the [[Royal Chalcedony Shield]], a prestigious award that made him an honorary son of Alderaan. Antilles' attendance at the ceremony was recorded in the "News Headlines" segment of [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo District's]] [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|edition]] of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]].<ref name="HNN" /> Two months later, the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] broke out, with the Republic and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] waging war against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="NEC" /> At some point following the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], the first [[Ground warfare/Legends|engagement]] of the conflict, Antilles was once again featured on the HoloNet news, along with [[Sei Taria/Legends|Sei Taria]],<ref name="HsG">The RPG sourcebook ''[[Hero's Guide]]'' contained a picture of a [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] transmission, which featured a portrait of Bail Antilles among other things. The picture also had a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] in [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I armor]], which was first seen at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]]. According to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', that battle occurred in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> the former [[Senior Administrative Aide/Legends|Staff Aide]] of Chancellor Valorum,<ref name="Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> and a red-plated [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]].<ref name="HsG" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Senator Antilles thinks only of the Core Worlds. Doubtless he would advocate a policy of nonintervention.|Finis Valorum|<ref name="cod" />}}
[[File:BailAntillesPortrait.png|thumb|left|180px|Bail Antilles of Alderaan was a dark-haired Human with blue eyes.]]
Bail Antilles was a tall,<ref name="cod" /> fair-skinned man<ref name="who" /> who sported dark [[Hair/Legends|hair]],<ref name="cod" /> a proud [[Nose/Legends|nose]] and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="who" /> His physical features were considered attractive by other members of his species.<ref name="cod" /> One of his Senatorial outfits was a white tunic with a high collar, leaf-shaped fabric clasps and an elaborate golden stole flowing down from the shoulders.<ref name="who" /> By wearing pure white uniforms, Antilles followed a tradition of Alderaanian ambassadors.<ref name="copl">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>

Although hard-working, dedicated and efficient in no little measure, Antilles was sometimes considered short-sighted. Indeed, as the representative of one of the Core Worlds, he paid little attention to the Outer Rim Territories, at least according to Finis Valorum. When his position on the Internal Activities Committee obligated him to represent the prosecution on Chancellor Valorum's trial, Antilles' body language expressed both anger and disappointment. While he apologized to Valorum for being the bringer of bad news, the Senator had the sense of doing his duty, in compliance with his strong anti-corruption principles.<ref name="cod" />

Despite his excellent reputation, certain members of the Jedi Order were suspicious of Antilles, including Masters [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]]<ref name="cod" /> and [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].<ref name="loe" /> When Valorum found himself under the gun, Tiin was concerned that he could be replaced by "the likes of Bail Antilles or Ainlee Teem," lumping together both politicians.<ref name="cod" /> According to Dooku, Valorum was a "known quantity" to the Jedi, while his potential successors Teem, Palpatine and Antilles had yet to disclose their true&mdash;and perhaps dangerous&mdash;agendas.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> Ironically, Dooku would later become a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and an [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] to Darth Sidious, Palpatine's Sith alter ego.<ref name="loe" />

When he broke for lunch after a hard morning's work, the Senator enjoyed drinking [[Gizer ale]] and going to the city for a meal. One of his favorite restaurants was located near the Courts Building of Coruscant,<ref name="cod" /> in the district known as "[[Plains of Coruscant|the Plains]]."<ref name="IWTPM">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]''</ref>

As an outspoken critic of bureaucratic corruption, Antilles disliked Senator Orn Free Taa of Ryloth, suspecting that the Twi'lek was guilty of many financial irregularities. However, the Alderaanian always did his best to hide his apprehension when meeting with Taa, listening to the Twi'lek's words and checking the truth about them later. Yet, he could not help addressing Taa with a slight touch of sarcasm.<ref name="cod" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Character origins===
{{Quote|Whitsun walks into the glass and chrome splendor of one of the famous nightclubs of Alderaan. He moves to the long mirrored bar, and sits next to a rough-looking man, BAIL ANTILLES, dressed in the distinctive gold and furs of the Galactic traders.|Extract from "The Star Wars: Rough Draft"|<ref name="RoughDraftTSW">[[The Star Wars rough draft|''The Star Wars'' rough draft]]</ref>}}
[[File:AntilliesMistake.png|thumb|right|200px|Leia's father was once erroneously referred to as "Bail Antillies."]]
The name "Bail Antilles" first appeared in [[May]] [[1974]], in the 132-page [[The Star Wars rough draft|rough draft]]<ref name="RoughDraftTSW" /> to the film that would become [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope">{{Film|IV}}</ref> In that early treatment, Antilles was a galactic trader and a confederate of the [[Aquillian Ranger/Legends|Aquillian Ranger]] [[Clieg Whitsun]]. He was described as a rugged-looking man wearing fur and golden ornaments.<ref name="Bendu">{{WebCite|url=http://starwarz.com/starkiller/2010/03/the-star-wars-rough-draft|text=The Star Wars&ndash;Rough Draft|work=Starkiller&ndash;The Jedi Bendu Script Site|archivedate=20120310205635}}</ref> [[1975|One year later]], in the ''[[Adventures of the Starkiller, Episode I: The Star Wars]]'', Antilles became an Aquillian Ranger himself and the co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the story's main protagonist, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends#Origins of Luke|Luke Starkiller]].<ref name="StarkillerDraft">{{WebCite|url=http://starwarz.com/starkiller/2010/03/adventures-of-the-starkiller-second-draft|text=Adventures of the Starkiller (Second Draft)|work=Starkiller&ndash;The Jedi Bendu Script Site|archivedate=20120310210800}}</ref> That first version of Antilles [[Bail Antilles (The Star Wars)|appears]] in the comic book series ''[[The Star Wars]]'', a [[Canon|non-canon]] adaptation of [[George Lucas]]'s 1974 draft for ''Star Wars''.<ref name="TSW1">[[The Star Wars 1|''The Star Wars'' 1]]</ref>

The revised fourth draft established the character of "Bail Antilles, [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] and Chairman of the Alderaan system" as the father of Princess [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] from the planet Alderaan.<ref name="ANHRFD">{{WebCite|url=https://www.starwarz.com/starkiller/star-wars-the-adventures-of-luke-starkiller-revised-fourth-draft|text=A New Hope Revised Fourth Draft|work=starwarz.com|archivedate=20240518134536}}</ref> When Princess Leia's homeworld was renamed Alderaan, the name "[[Ogana Major|Ogana]]" was slightly respelled and attributed to the royal family.<ref name="Alderaan Databank">{{DB|location|alderaan|Alderaan}}</ref> Bail Antilles was accordingly renamed Bail Organa, and went on to be mentioned by name in the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of ''A New Hope'',<ref name="ANHN">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novelization]]</ref> although he was only referred to simply as Princess Leia's father in the film itself.<ref name="Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope" /> In [[Star Wars (1977) 2|''Star Wars'' (1977) 2]], the second issue of the film's [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Star Wars (1977)|adaptation]] by [[Marvel Comics|Marvel]], Leia's father was erroneously referred to as "Bail Antillies [sic], Viceroy of Alderaan."<ref name="Star Wars 2">[[Star Wars (1977) 2|''Star Wars'' (1977) 2]]</ref> Eventually, Bail Antilles was established as a separate character from Organa during the development of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[prequel trilogy]], specifically as Organa's predecessor as the senator of Alderaan.<ref name="MisID">{{Blog|holocron|29|Mistaken Identities}}</ref>

===Portrayal===
{{Quote|Alderaan seconds the motion for a vote of no confidence in Chancellor Valorum.|Adrian Dunbar as "Bail Organa," in a deleted scene from ''Star Wars Episode I: The Phantom Menace''|audio=AdrianDunbarOrgana-TPM.flac|<ref name="IllustratedScreenplay">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace Illustrated Screenplay|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace Illustrated Screenplay'']]</ref>}}
[[File:DunbarBluescreen.png|thumb|left|200px|Adrian Dunbar was originally cast as Bail Organa.]]
In [[1999]], the [[Wikipedia:Ireland|Irish]] actor [[Adrian Dunbar]] was cast as Bail Organa and was set to appear in the Senate sequence of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. In his original scene, Dunbar's Organa seconded Queen Amidala's Vote of No Confidence that toppled Valorum's Chancellorship.<ref name="dbOrg">{{DB|character|bailorgana|Organa, Bail}}</ref> However, references to "Bail Organa" in the script were changed to "Bail Antilles" during production, making Dunbar's character a separate politician.<ref name="MisID" />

While filming his scenes, Dunbar was asked to perform with an [[Wikipedia:American English|American]] accent at the last moment. The actor practiced a bit and delivered his lines as requested on the day of filming. After he did it, he heard a voice saying: "That is the worst American accent I've ever heard." When Dunbar peered out through the light to see who was mocking him, he realized it was his old friend [[Liam Neeson]], who played Jedi Master [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] in the film.<ref name="TFN">{{WebCite|url=http://www.theforce.net/episode1/story/Adrian_Dunbar_talks_about_being_cut_from_Episode_I_75524.asp|text=Adrian Dunbar talks about being cut from Episode I|work=TheForce.Net|archivedate=20170331044645}}</ref> Ultimately, the footage containing Dunbar was cut from the final film,<ref name="dbOrg" /> and Antilles was only briefly mentioned in ''The Phantom Menace'' as a nominee to succeed Chancellor Valorum.<ref name="TPM" /> Dunbar received a telephone call from George Lucas to let him know he would not make it into the film. The Irish actor later expressed his disappointment that his scenes were cut, especially since the only reason he was to take part in ''The Phantom Menace'' was because Lucas initially wanted to include him in the next two films.<ref name="TFN" />

In May [[2001]], ''Star Wars'' author [[James Luceno]] used Adrian Dunbar's likeness in his novel ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' to portray Bail Antilles,<ref name="dbOrg" /> in keeping with the changes in the movie script.<ref name="MisID" /> When [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] was released [[2002|one year later]], [[Jimmy Smits]] was re-cast as Bail Organa, and Antilles made no further film appearances.<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>

Meanwhile, the character portrayed by Dunbar had been further associated with Bail Antilles in the [[March 21]], 2002, issue of the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]], an in-universe news website that was launched as a prelude to ''Attack of the Clones''. In "Senator Horox Ryyder Retires," an article from that HoloNet News issue, both Antilles and Organa were mentioned, with a picture of both together. The illustrated rendering of Antilles, drawn by [[Joe Corroney]], was evidently based on the only published picture of Dunbar in costume.<ref name="HNN" />

Despite the early [[Retroactive continuity|retcon]] during production, some sources had already gone to print identifying the character played by Dunbar as Bail Organa, thus giving rise to a notable case of mistaken identity in ''Star Wars'' [[canon]]. [[Leland Chee]], the arbiter of the [[Holocron continuity database]] at [[Lucasfilm]], addressed the issue in a blog post in [[2006]].<ref name="MisID" /> Since then, the confusion between the two Bails has been repeated at least once. In the book ''[[Star Wars Annual 2009]]'', Antilles was listed as one of several senators who were members of the [[Loyalist Committee/Legends|Loyalist Committee]] around 22 BBY.<ref name="SWA9">''[[Star Wars Annual 2009]]''</ref> However, Antilles was not a senator anymore at that time,<ref name="HNN" /> and it was his successor Organa who was part of the Committee.<ref name="AOTC" />
